expected_observed: Negative/unaligned capture with models, coloured fractional geometry and resident-only geometry matches legacy whole-snapshot package bytes.
320 chunks require three <=128-entry owner batches plus begin/final validation calls; observed progress 0,40,80,100.
Canonical edits, resident-only changes, model revisions and terrain ABA invalidate partial snapshots or subsequent terrain reads.
Cancellation rejects pending work, leaves no published package and permits retry.
Menu marks busy before snapshot requests; another capture while busy creates no whole-world or extra region snapshot.
Detached sources retain old canonical and resident geometry after later source edits.
tradeoffs: Model metadata and region lookup still materialize; canonical history and world geometry are not disk backed.
Global canonical/resident epochs conservatively reject some unrelated changes; no live-map iterator spans frames.
COW sharing rotates bucket ownership; subsequent edits may allocate bucket copies.
Batch count is a resource bound, not a measured 100 ms stall or memory/FPS guarantee.
